title.zh: 蚂蚁UBTree改进推测解码：并行筛选草稿树，让大模型一次验证更多Token
title.en: 蚂蚁UBTree改进推测解码：并行筛选草稿树，让大模型一次验证更多Token

current_state.zh: Ant's Bailing team open-sourced UBTree, a speculative-decoding method that parallel-screens draft-tree branches with a lightweight linkage model, raising average speedup on Qwen3-4B from 5.95x to 6.88x over the prior DFlash 2 selector.
